details.report: Root repair: decision-bearing label mappings now live in and digest-bind the canonical Navigator snapshot; GitHub null bodies normalize to sealed zero-byte evidence; evidence admission uses one 8 MiB bounded regular descriptor-read seam, collision checks, content-addressed capability handles, immutable byte ownership, duplicate snapshot-ID rejection, and root/capability verification at runtime; UTF-8 page reads credit merged interval coverage only after successful decode, and reconstructed Recorder coverage uses the same bounded interval model; assisted inputs now reject noncanonical/coercible paths, unsafe or overlapping environment policy names, non-positive issue identities, and invalid public run locators before publication. Added regression coverage in test/assisted-evidence-input-closure.test.ts and updated snapshot fixtures. Verification: npm run typecheck; npm test (392 passed, 0 failed, 5 skipped); npm run build:recorder; git diff --check; npm pack --dry-run. No timeout policy, second tracker, worktree manager, or prose inference added. No authorized finding was declined.
